title: Foundation Methods Portfolio Review Session Agenda

timed_blocks.objective: Open review packet and confirm evidence boundary.
prompts: Confirm the learner is presenting public-evidence-bounded work, not claiming private RISD assessment.
Open the portfolio review index row and linked brief/source/reference/export artifacts.

timed_blocks.objective: Learner presents final artifacts before process evidence.
prompts: Ask the learner to present the final artifacts before process evidence.
Stop after the artifact read; defer process explanation until reviewer has recorded first impressions.

timed_blocks.objective: Check visible constraints against source-bound evidence.
prompts: Check the work against the source-bound constraints and explicitly separate observed evidence from inference.
Which constraints are visible in the final artifacts?
What changed after critique, and what evidence proves the change?

timed_blocks.objective: Review critique notes, before/after revisions, and decision rationale.
prompts: Ask what changed after critique and require a before/after example.
Which source-grounded reading, schedule, or assignment detail changed a design decision?
What remains uncertain because the public corpus lacks private classroom material?

timed_blocks.objective: Resolve, disclose, or keep each evidence warning as blocking.
prompts: Discuss each unresolved evidence warning and decide whether it is resolved, disclosed, or still blocking.
Fill final artifact, process, critique, revision, source-boundary, and export package slots before review.

timed_blocks.objective: Fill reviewer feedback status updates and revision items.
prompts: Copy the reviewer feedback template row into the reviewer feedback import file and use only allowed evidence refs.
Regenerate the corpus so reviewer feedback imports become revision queue rows.

timed_blocks.objective: Decide whether gate status can be promoted or remains blocked.
prompts: Use gate status suggestions to copy verified satisfied checks into the learner gate status import.
Regenerate and confirm gate status summary, review index, and portfolio brief reflect the updated readiness state.

capture_outputs: reviewer feedback import row with evidence refs
revision queue rows for unresolved work
learner gate status import update when all checks are satisfied
post_session_actions: Copy the template row into self_study_portfolio_gate_status_import.jsonl, attach evidence_refs, update check statuses, and regenerate.
Update the learner status import with satisfied checks, evidence refs, and notes before regenerating.
Keep unresolved source boundaries in the next critique memo rather than smoothing them over.
smoke_test_note: Smoke fixture smoke_feedback_reviewer_handoff_portfolio_milestone_01_foundation_methods proves this milestone can round-trip through reviewer feedback, revision queue, and gate status suggestion artifacts.
provenance_note: Generated time-boxed critique agenda from portfolio review workflow and reviewer handoff artifacts.
